data_check_issues_handled_at_check.name: data_check_issues_handled_at_check
data_check_issues_handled_at_check.value:
("data_check_issues"."status" = 'open' and "data_check_issues"."handled_at" is null)
        or ("data_check_issues"."status" = 'handled' and "data_check_issues"."handled_at" is not null)

data_check_state_counts_check.name: data_check_state_counts_check
data_check_state_counts_check.value:
"data_check_state"."orphan_event_count" >= 0
        and "data_check_state"."orphan_relation_count" >= 0
        and "data_check_state"."orphan_case_count" >= 0
        and "data_check_state"."error_count" >= 0
        and "data_check_state"."warning_count" >= 0
        and "data_check_state"."open_count" >= 0
        and "data_check_state"."handled_count" >= 0

semantic_index_state_active_model_check.name: semantic_index_state_active_model_check
semantic_index_state_active_model_check.value:
("semantic_index_state"."active_model_code" is null and "semantic_index_state"."status" = 'empty')
        or "semantic_index_state"."active_model_code" is not null

semantic_jobs_entity_target_check.name: semantic_jobs_entity_target_check
semantic_jobs_entity_target_check.value:
("semantic_jobs"."job_type" = 'incremental'
          and "semantic_jobs"."entity_type" is not null
          and "semantic_jobs"."entity_id" is not null)
        or ("semantic_jobs"."job_type" in ('download', 'full_index')
          and "semantic_jobs"."entity_type" is null
          and "semantic_jobs"."entity_id" is null)

semantic_jobs_progress_check.name: semantic_jobs_progress_check
semantic_jobs_progress_check.value:
"semantic_jobs"."state_version" >= 0
        and "semantic_jobs"."processed_items" >= 0
        and "semantic_jobs"."total_items" >= 0
        and "semantic_jobs"."processed_items" <= "semantic_jobs"."total_items"
        and "semantic_jobs"."downloaded_bytes" >= 0
        and "semantic_jobs"."total_bytes" >= 0
        and "semantic_jobs"."downloaded_bytes" <= "semantic_jobs"."total_bytes"
        and "semantic_jobs"."attempts" >= 0

semantic_jobs_lease_check.name: semantic_jobs_lease_check
semantic_jobs_lease_check.value:
("semantic_jobs"."status" = 'running'
          and "semantic_jobs"."lease_owner" is not null
          and "semantic_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is not null)
        or ("semantic_jobs"."status" <> 'running')

semantic_jobs_terminal_timestamp_check.name: semantic_jobs_terminal_timestamp_check
semantic_jobs_terminal_timestamp_check.value:
("semantic_jobs"."status" = 'queued'
          and "semantic_jobs"."started_at" is null
          and "semantic_jobs"."completed_at" is null)
        or ("semantic_jobs"."status" = 'running'
          and "semantic_jobs"."started_at" is not null
          and "semantic_jobs"."completed_at" is null)
        or ("semantic_jobs"."status" in ('succeeded', 'failed')
          and "semantic_jobs"."started_at" is not null
          and "semantic_jobs"."completed_at" is not null)

semantic_model_settings_downloaded_at_ch.name: semantic_model_settings_downloaded_at_check
semantic_model_settings_downloaded_at_ch.value:
("semantic_model_settings"."download_status" = 'downloaded' and "semantic_model_settings"."downloaded_at" is not null)
        or ("semantic_model_settings"."download_status" <> 'downloaded' and "semantic_model_settings"."downloaded_at" is null)
